info.title: v2.ams.get_content_performance
info.description: Retrieve content performance of the shop

get.description: Retrieve content performance of the shop

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: affiliate_id
parameters.description: Search for the contents published by affiliates with the affiliate id entered.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end_date must be: - Equal to start_date for "Day" period type - Saturday for "Week" period type - The last day of a Month for "Month" period type. If the selected month is the current month, the end_date should be the latest data date - The latest data date for "Last7d" period type - The latest data date for "Last30d" period type Note: - The end_date must be later than the start_date and earlier than the latest data date - The latest data date can be obtained by using "AmsMarker" in the v2.ams.get_performance_data_update_time API.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Search for the contents with the searched product included (precise search).

parameters.name: order_type
parameters.description: Order Type. Applicable values: PlacedOrder ConfirmedOrder: Note: - Placed orders are orders (COD and non-COD) that buyers have successfully placed, including paid and unpaid orders. - Confirmed orders are either non-COD orders that have been paid for or COD orders that have been confirmed for shipping (usually 30 mins after placing the order).

parameters.name: page_no
parameters.description: Specifies the page number of data to return in the current call. Starting from 1. if data is more than one page, the page_no can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Each result set is returned as a page of entries. Use the "page_size" filters to control the maximum number of entries to retrieve per page (i.e., per call). This integer value is used to specify the maximum number of entries to return in a single "page" of data. The limit of page_size if between 1 and 20.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: period_type
parameters.description: Period Type. Applicable values: Day Week Month Last7d Last30d Note: The start date and end date must align with the Period Type.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The start_date must be: - Any day in the past three calendar months for "Day" period type - Sunday for "Week" period type - The 1st day of a Month for "Month" period type - The date that is 6 days prior to the latest data date for "Last7d" period type - The date that is 29 days prior to the latest data date for "Last30d" period type Note: The latest data date can be obtained by using "AmsMarker" in the v2.ams.get_performance_data_update_time API.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/ams/get_content_performance?access_token=access_token&affiliate_id=11146330000&channel=ShopeeVideo&end_date=20250831&item_id=14016184405&order_type=ConfirmedOrder&page_no=1&page_size=20&partner_id=partner_id&period_type=Last30d&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&start_date=20250801&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Livestream: The livestream start time. Video: The video post time.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Login or Shopee account username associated with the affiliate.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Number of products associated with the content.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: views
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The total viewed pv of the content of this shop within the selected time range

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: likes
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The total number of likes for the content of this shop within the selected time range

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: comments
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The total number of comments for the content of this shop within the selected time range

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: sales
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The total sales of the content associated with the shop orders within the selected time range

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: orders
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The total number of orders associated with the shop for the content in the selected time range

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: items_sold

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: total_count
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: This is to indicate the whole number of items.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: has_more
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: This is to indicate whether the list is more than one page. If this value is true, you may want to continue to check next page to retrieve the rest of datas.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Effective query date range. Invalid input ranges will be automatically shifted.
